attributionText.heading: Understanding Our Attribution Practices
attributionText.para:
At DigitalDSA, we are committed to respecting intellectual property rights and adhering to licensing agreements for all third-party assets used on this platform.
This page provides a consolidated attribution for images, logos, and other digital elements featured on our website.

resources.para: Some images, icons, and illustrations on this website are sourced from Freepik, Pexels, and FlatIcons, licensed under their respective terms.
resources.attributionAlert: Images and graphics used on this website are sourced from Freepik, Pexels, Unsplash, and FlatIcons. All rights to these assets remain with their original creators.
resources.intro: Where required, usage complies with the licensing terms of each platform :
resources.footer: If you believe an image on our website requires further attribution or needs to be removed, please contact us.

logo.heading: Bank Logos & Trademarks
logo.secHeading: Usage Disclaimer for Bank Logos & Trademarks

list.desc: All bank logos, brand names, and trademarks displayed on this website are the exclusive property of their respective owners.
Logos are used for informational and identification purposes only, assisting users in recognizing financial institutions.
DigitalDSA does not claim ownership, affiliation, sponsorship, or endorsement from any financial institution unless explicitly stated.
If any institution requests specific attribution or removal, they may contact us for resolution.

compliance.heading: Compliance & Fair Use
compliance.secPara:
At DigitalDSA, we:

  • ✔ Ensure proper licensing and fair use of all third-party assets.
  • ✔ Do not modify or alter trademarks or copyrighted materials without authorization.
  • ✔ Comply with all copyright laws, licensing agreements, and fair use policies.

If any content owner or company has concerns about attribution, licensing, or usage, they can request modifications, credits, or removal by reaching out to us.
